meta.source: Reference dashboard shared by Mohammad on 2026-10-22 (dark device-shell look) + mockup v0 risk language

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind the shell. Never put text directly on it except the greeting.

tokens.name: shell
tokens.usage: The rounded device shell (radius-xl) that holds the whole app; also the side panel.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards on the shell: issues, metrics, plans, chat replies.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Rows inside a card, inputs, the track of the approval slider, chart grid ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card outlines. Control borders use ink-faint instead (3:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, big numbers, icons on card.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, captions, chart axis labels. 4.5:1 on card in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only and control borders: placeholder, disabled, the grey first line of the greeting at 48px. Not for body text.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: THE accent. Only where the user's approval is needed: approval slider knob, sensitive chip, the highlighted bar of today. Never decorative.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Amber text on amber-soft or card (chip labels, the cost line). amber itself is for fills.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an approval card and the sensitive chip.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icons on amber.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Ordinary bars in charts (the non-highlighted days). Never text.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Healthy, done, automatic (read-only) actions; healthy metric bars; the done tick.

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the automatic chip and success notes.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Metric lines, the selected point on a chart, info links. One violet thing per card.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Errors and broken things: the outline of a failing issue row, FATAL in logs.

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an error issue row.

tokens.name: limit
tokens.usage: Text of a limitation note (the API cannot do this).

tokens.name: limit-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a limitation note.

styles.name: greeting-light
styles.usage: First line of the two-weight greeting, in ink-faint. Only on the home screen.

styles.name: greeting
styles.usage: Second line of the greeting, in ink: the one-sentence state of the user's app.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The big light number on a metric card. Persian digits, tabular.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Screen titles and the headline of a result.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Card titles. Medium weight, like the reference.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: اپ سه بار از حافظه بیرون زده. پیشنهادم ارتقای RAM است.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Line under a card title, in ink-muted.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Logs, env names, URLs, commands. Always LTR-isolated inside Persian text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter; row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Shell padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between the greeting and the card grid.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips' inner icons, log blocks, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows inside cards (issue rows, steps), icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The device shell and the side panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, the approval slider, search field, day badges.

tokens.name: shadow-shell
tokens.usage: Only the device shell. Cards are flat.
